# WabilHuda (wabilhuda.com)

> Free AI-powered Quran learning platform for Hifz, tajweed recitation, Hadith, Tafseer, tasbih, and prayer times.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://wabilhuda.com/
- Read Quran (114 Surahs): https://wabilhuda.com/quran
- AI Hifz memorization: https://wabilhuda.com/memorize
- Hadith of the day: https://wabilhuda.com/hadith
- Juz (Para) browser: https://wabilhuda.com/juz
- 99 Names of Allah: https://wabilhuda.com/names
- Everyday Duas: https://wabilhuda.com/duas
- Digital Tasbih: https://wabilhuda.com/tasbih
- Prayer times: https://wabilhuda.com/prayer

## Features

- Uthmani Arabic with tajweed colour coding
- Urdu and English translations, word-by-word, Tafseer
- AI Hifz coach with spaced repetition
- Microphone recitation checking
- Family learning and healthy competitions
